instagram_reel.text:
This one surprises a lot of vegetarians. Answer and source in the video.

Answer: No. Its EU protected recipe requires calf rennet. Look for hard cheeses made with microbial or vegetable rennet.
Source: EU PDO specification, Parmigiano Reggiano

Save this for your next cheese run.

youtube.title: Is real Parmigiano Reggiano vegetarian? #shorts
youtube.text:
Answer: No. Its EU protected recipe requires calf rennet. Look for hard cheeses made with microbial or vegetable rennet.
Source: EU PDO specification, Parmigiano Reggiano (https://www.gob.mx/cms/uploads/attachment/file/245696/IT_Parmigiano_Reggiano.pdf)
